Learning of Dale Brown's death makes my heart hurt badly. I immediately went to my voice mail box to hear him tell me he loves me again and again. Dale was one of a kind. He was the most generous soul I have ever known, and likely ever will. I am blessed like thousands of others, to have known him and loved him and to have learned endless lessons. He was a proud son of North Dakota with a heart as big as the prairies themselves. As we mourn and remember Dale over the next several days, like you, I will reflect a lot. Today I joined the community of Hazen in dedicating a sculpture of the US Air Force’s SR-71  Blackbird and Hazen’s very own exceptional patriot, Major General Eldon Joersz. 
 
For nearly 24 years the iconic SR-71 operated as a strategic reconnaissance plane flying strategic missions from 1966 to 1990. Fifty years ago, Major General Eldon Joersz made history by becoming the fastest flying man alive when he flew the SR-71 over three times the speed of sound, reaching  a record breaking 2,193.176 mph. A record that still stands! 
 
“Today was not just about marking history. It's not just about pride. It is about imagining the future. It’s also about these young people who are here, that never know what it is to have had to go to war. But now they'll be able to come here, see this monument, and understand the cost of it.”
 
As Americans, let us embrace this bold and adventurous spirit, pushing past existing limits to redefine what is truly possible. Retired Major General Eldon Joersz, we thank you for your exceptional service to our country! Please accept the thanks of North Dakota.

Joined Dagen McDowell on @FoxBusiness’ “Big Money in the Morning” to discuss Starshield and Ukraine.  Space is critical to modern warfare, and we need to ensure the US and our allies have access to these critical space systems like Starshield. We also discussed the need to refine our own oil and the opportunity of permitting reform which would benefit all forms of linear infrastructure.

Getting ready to join my weekly radio town hall with @scotthennen. 🎙️

Watch live on @BEKNewsTV or tune in to @theflagwzfg at 10:00 a.m. CT / 11:00 a.m. ET.
https://t.co/982l2iSfXO

The benefit of being a Senator from North Dakota is I get to know all of the NDHA members and have an opportunity to meet with them and hear firsthand about their successes and challenges. This makes me a stronger advocate for them and their colleagues in other states will benefit as a result.

After hearing about the challenges faced by Sea Foam, I led a delegation letter calling on @USCPSC to get this right and stop applying portable fuel container regulations to fuel additives. Good to see the Commission finalized its new course of action. We need sensible regulations to protect consumers without the bureaucracy getting in the way of North Dakota businesses.

The Offerdahl Engineering Complex is the best kind of playground for @NDSU students to transform their curiosity and training into the workforce of tomorrow. Nothing beats hands on learning to foster American innovation! https://t.co/9v5XJ43xj5

It was refreshing to visit with this amazing group of @NDSU students. Their passion, curiosity, and engagement are making the future brighter for North Dakota and for the rest of the world. https://t.co/Y0JJ94Oefg

Impressive to see and operate some of the groundbreaking technologies under development at @NDSU’s Tech Park, NDeavor, where they are taking innovative ideas and putting them out in the world for use. The team’s agility and precision is what our military, first responders and entrepreneurs need to be competitive and successful. It is great to see North Dakota leading the way!

Fascinating tour at @NDSU Biotech Innovation Core seeing innovation in action. Scott’s from Rolla and Kaycie is from West Fargo. They, along with the students and businesses they work with, are building on North Dakota’s world-class health and agriculture ecosystem. These homegrown solutions are what our state, nation, and the world needs.

Big things are happening in medical discovery here in North Dakota, and this innovative ecosystem has always been here, from our Norwegian ancestors to today. This has always been a place where people take an idea, put in hard work, apply intellectual rigor, and turn it into something that makes a difference. North Dakota, and especially the Fargo region, has what it takes—the talent, tools, and drive—to advance the bioscience sector and be part of the solution. I love how we don’t need to ask, “Why not in North Dakota?” because our people are already answering the question.

This drone was impressive when Ukrainian military leaders showed it to me inside a warehouse where it was undergoing testing. It’s even more impressive two weeks later in the field already saving lives. https://t.co/zbDoyyvUUj

Had a great day in the heart of North Dakota’s Prairie Potholes with local farmers and @USFWS Director Brian Nesvik. The federal government’s overreach has squashed private property rights and is a breach of contract. Thank you to Director Nesvik for coming back to North Dakota to see the problem on the ground. It’s time to kill the illegal Biden rule and make decades of wrongs right for landowners.

I joined @margbrennan on @FaceTheNation to discuss my trip to Ukraine with @SenatorWicker. Putin is a thug targeting Ukrainian civilians. We discussed options to help @ZelenskyyUa win the war and protect his people. https://t.co/BF7dO2hHjK
Getting ready to go on @FaceTheNation to discuss my Ukraine trip and other topics. Tune in, 10:30 a.m. ET. https://t.co/UsUM3VZavt

It was a wonderful evening celebrating Diwali with Bismarck’s Indian community!

Diwali reminds us of the power of light over darkness and the importance of choosing hope, even in challenging times. We are grateful for the opportunity to celebrate this meaningful tradition, experience such a vibrant culture, and recognize the many contributions the Indian community makes to our state.

Thank you for your warm hospitality and for allowing us to share in this special celebration. We are grateful to have you as part of our North Dakota community and honored to serve you!

This @USOCC report shines the light on the debanking perpetrators over the last couple decades. It’s blatant discrimination. It’s why we need to pass my Fair Access to Banking Act. https://t.co/2G2muGtsiX

The Point Defense Battle Lab at @319thRW is an incredible asset to North Dakota’s defense ecosystem. Col. Rosales and the dedicated airmen at Grand Forks Air Force Base are crucial to countering small UAS incursions across the Air Force, and it’s great to hear they’ve already run more than a dozen exercises this year.

Today’s @usocc report confirms all nine of the biggest national banks had policies to restrict services over politics, religion, and lawful business practices. This is further proof we need to pass my Fair Access to Banking Act to ensure these banks make lending and service decisions based on impartial analysis, not political favoritism.

Had a valuable bilateral discussion with commander of United States European Command and Supreme Allied Commander Europe General Alexus G. Grynkewich and heard updates from Lithuanian Defense Minister Robertas Kuanas at the @WarsawForum https://t.co/NiSjSxcV2y https://t.co/kqLTcCj94R

.@WarsawForum was a great place to have candid and meaningful conversations about the future of European and transatlantic security. Aligning with defense officials and colleagues from across the region regarding the future of our alliance is more important than ever.

Had great discussions today with @ZelenskyyUa and @SenatorWicker, along with other defense and policy leaders on the challenges we face, our shared security priorities, and how we can strengthen our strategic partnership. https://t.co/hT2nNyZaFa

Pat Conmy embodied the best of North Dakota and leaves behind a rich legacy of public service. Kris and I will keep his family in our prayers as they gather to mourn their loss and cherish the many happy memories they shared with Pat.

It’s National 4-H Week!

From the classroom to the farm and everywhere in between, 4-H gives young North Dakotans opportunities to learn, lead, serve, and grow.

This week, we recognize the 4-H members, their families, and the volunteers who lead in our communities. https://t.co/9lNjto7KWy

Grateful to @SindicsGenerals Charles Ensenada Reig for hospitality at @oscepa in Andorra, where European solidarity with Ukrain was top priority. Good discussions and commitments made by allies. Great to meet with the Ukrainian delegates. https://t.co/tLSavCF3QZ

Three years ago today, Israel endured one of the darkest days in its history as Hamas carried out a series of horrific terrorist attacks against innocent civilians. 
 
On this solemn anniversary, we reaffirm our commitment to Israel’s right to exist and our resolve to stand against terrorism, senseless violence, and the rising antisemitism we see around us.

Joined over 100 colleagues in sending a letter to @HHSGov Inspector General T. March Bell calling for an @OIGatHHS investigation into Planned Parenthood’s use of taxpayer funding.

Given the significant taxpayer resources flowing through federal health programs, recipient organizations must operate with transparency, integrity, and full compliance with federal standards.

The American people deserve to know if their money is being used to finance the People’s Liberation Army. This is why I am joining several of my colleagues in cosponsoring the Know Your Sanctioned Securities Act and the Protecting U.S. Investors from Chinese Military Companies Act. The bills are tough on the Chinese Communist Party and give our government the tools it needs to stop funneling hard-earned money to our adversary.
https://t.co/XY35Da7xGA

Watch the full interview below

@ScottJenningsKY is right. Democrats want us dependent on refineries in Russia, the Middle East, and China. We haven’t built a new refinery since the 1970s, and only about 30% of our refineries are optimized for light sweet American crude. Oil-rich California imports nearly 60% of its oil from foreign sources. I have been sounding the alarm for quite some time. The status quo is unacceptable.

https://t.co/lzRGWmHxky

I could not be more honored to be part of this historic moment, as a legend opens his exhibition in North Dakota’s legendary library.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.

bills.vote_scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.

overlap.cycle_note: Fallback cycle: these figures are from the 2024 two-year cycle (most recent completed election), not the current 2030 cycle. The 2030 cycle has no itemized donors yet.
